lucy: Hi team, lucy here (new runtime dev). Trying to build locally and getting unresolved references to cudart symbols during link. Any quick pointers?

lucy: Build invocation: `cmake -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo && cmake --build build -j16`
lucy: Link excerpt:
```
/usr/bin/ld: /opt/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so: undefined reference to `cudaLaunchKernel_v2`
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
noah: welcome! :wave: that symbol is in cudart but the complaint usually means it's picking up mismatched lib vs headers or different runtime library version. what does `readlink -f /usr/local/cuda` show?
arjun: also run `grep -R "CUDART" build/CMakeCache.txt || true` to see if cmake cached an old path. we had cases where distro packages and runfile installs coexist and cmake picks the wrong one.
lucy: `readlink -f /usr/local/cuda` -> `/usr/local/cuda-11.7`
lucy: distro package manager shows `nvidia-driver-535` and apt lists `cuda-toolkit-11-7`
tiffany: FYI our dev docker image uses CUDA 12.2 and we build with `-DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=/usr/local/cuda-12.2` in CI. If your host is 11.7 there could be missing newer symbols. two options: install matching toolkit (recommended) or set up the repo to use the compatibility shim we keep in `third_party/cuda_compat/` to weak-link missing symbols.
arjun: did you run `scripts/setup_dev_env.sh`? that exports CUDA_HOME and tweaks RPATH for binaries (avoids system loader surprises).
lucy: i missed running that. ran it now; it pointed to `/usr/local/cuda-12.2` which i don't have.
oah: if you can't install 12.2, try adding `-DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/cuda-11.7/lib64"` to keep the runtime libs consistent, but it's fragile. installing matching toolkit is cleaner.
lucy: installed CUDA 12.2 toolkit from apt (package `cuda-toolkit-12-2`) and re-ran `./scripts/setup_dev_env.sh` and full clean build. Link succeeded. thanks!
tiffany: great — could you drop a quick note in #eng-runtime about host OS and toolkit version? we track common mismatches to update the README. also, please file a tiny PR to add a troubleshooting bullet for cudart/cudaLaunchKernel symbol errors.
lucy: will do. thanks for the rapid help everyone.
setup-bot: Hi lucy! Don't forget to complete the "Runtime dev setup" checklist in Notion and claim a mentor.
_description: Onboarding thread: new runtime engineer hits cudart/cudaLaunchKernel undefined reference due to CUDA toolkit mismatch; team suggests setup script, rpath workaround, and installing matching toolkit (12.2)
